summaries.semantic_outcome: Both owner-window-created virtual Wii devices retain hid-generic after ignore_special_drivers is restored to 0. Before and after the bounded native Dolphin arms, each exact HID root has zero input companions and libxwiimote iface creation returns -19 (ENODEV). Kernel evdev MotionPlus axes and xwiimote access are absent in this binding. This is a test/dev host trade-off, not a physical or release qualification.
